title: Secure a pull request workflow reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for secure a pull request workflow should include: pull_request:, permissions:, read.
answer.example:
name: Validate untrusted pull requests without secrets
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run non-privileged checks
        run: echo "Replace with the project test command; do not expose deploy secrets"
answer.verification: A pull request targeting `main` runs read-only validation without deployment credentials. In a real workflow, review checkout ref behavior and dependencies before executing contributor-controlled code.
